Frequently asked questions

Which restaurants accept EBT in Gardena?

Gardena has 32 restaurants authorized for the SNAP Restaurant Meals Program, including Jack in the Box, Del Taco, McDonald's, Yoshinoya. Each accepts EBT from eligible recipients for prepared meals.

Can anyone use EBT at these Gardena restaurants?

No — only recipients enrolled in the Restaurant Meals Program: those who are 60 or older, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness (and their spouses). California is a participating state.

What can I buy with EBT at a restaurant in Gardena?

Hot and ready-to-eat meals. Alcohol, tobacco and non-food items aren't covered, and most states don't allow EBT to pay tips. It draws from your regular SNAP balance.
